entities.summary: Anthony J. O'Connell was an Irish-born prelate of the Roman Catholic church. He served as the first bishop of the Diocese of Knoxville in Tennessee from 1988 to 1998. He later served as the third bishop of the Diocese of Palm Beach in Florida from 1999 to 2002.
